svg.title: Population bottleneck: reveal 3
svg.desc: Cumulative reveal 3 of three. The original bottle holds an irregular blue, white, and sparse yellow bead mixture; starting positions and counts are schematic. A tilted bottle passes beads one at a time through a narrow neck into a receiving cylinder. Exactly two blue beads are falling. The separate final cylinder contains exactly five blue beads and one white bead, with no yellow bead. Simplified oblique cylinder illustration; not to scale.
